tools.name: get_site_overview
tools.description: Return public site identity, machine-readable endpoints and MCP endpoint information for ABC Remonty Oleba.

tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Search published public WordPress pages/posts on oleba.pl using locality-aware service relevance. Returns canonical URLs, titles, excerpts, match diagnostics and machine-readable representation URLs.

tools.name: get_content
tools.description: Resolve a public WordPress item by numeric ID, slug or same-site URL and return Markdown/text/metadata. Password-protected, unpublished and noindex content is refused.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: Return the curated public Oleba service catalog as stable machine-readable service objects linked to canonical public content.

tools.name: get_service
tools.description: Resolve a service by stable service id or natural-language name and return its primary public page, structured price rows and related realizations.

tools.name: ask_oleba
tools.description: Compose a compact, source-linked answer bundle from the structured Oleba service catalog, public cennik, service-area evidence and realization portfolio. Deterministic and read-only: missing facts are reported, never guessed.

tools.name: check_service_area
tools.description: Distinguish a documented service/location offer from merely having (or not having) a published realization. Never interprets absence of public evidence as proof that Oleba refuses a locality.

tools.name: get_prices
tools.description: Parse the public renovation cennik into structured rows. Query is optional. Returned prices are public informational ranges/amounts, not binding offers.

tools.name: get_realization
tools.description: Resolve one public realization/gallery post and return structured project metadata, evidence, media links and optional machine-readable content.

tools.name: get_price_information
tools.description: Find context for a service or phrase on the public Oleba renovation price-list page. Returns informational excerpts, not a binding quote.

tools.name: get_location_pages
tools.description: Find public Oleba pages/posts relevant to a locality such as Piaseczno, Ursynów, Mokotów, Józefosław or Konstancin-Jeziorna.

tools.name: get_realizations
tools.description: Search public Oleba project/gallery realization content by locality and/or topic. Generic service, local landing and price-list pages are intentionally demoted or excluded. This searches published site content only and does not access private customer records.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_site, get_content, get_realization, get_location_pages, get_renovation_calculator, get_realizations_a2ui · Private data: get_content, get_realizations, get_paint_calculator · Public sink: get_realization.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_site, get_content, get_realization, get_location_pages, get_renovation_calculator, get_realizations_a2ui · Private data: get_content, get_realizations, get_paint_calculator · Public sink: get_realization

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
